_comment: Demo seller price list. payTo values name env vars, so the repo holds no addresses. Several prices = several x402 `accepts` options (used for CAP). Routes may override network and facilitator_url: sol-* routes sell on Solana devnet via the PayAI facilitator.

report.description: Full market report (scenario 3: high value, needs a human)

dataset.description: Dataset export; full $2.00 or sample $0.40 (CAP demo)

sol-clip.description: Stock clip for a music video (Solana devnet, $0.30)

sol-stats.description: Daily streaming stats (plays, listeners) for the requested period ?from=&to= (Solana devnet, $0.05)

sol-stats-stale.description: Daily streaming stats, latest and complete (Solana devnet, $0.05). Demo: ignores the requested period

sol-stats-empty.description: Daily streaming stats for the requested period (Solana devnet, $0.05). Demo: returns no rows
